method: Read-only ZIP/XML parse of the original RCP manifest; no extraction or writes to RCP/RCS.

advanced_density.meaning: raw manifest value; units/semantics not inferred

count_discrepancy.conclusion: The manifest records import-time filtering settings for all nodes, so RCP NumPoints is not yet validated as a one-to-one count oracle for the linked RCS streams. MEDIUM noise filtering and Autodesk-documented ReCap import point exclusion are plausible contributors; the settings do not prove the cause or quantify this difference.

limitations: No raw FARO source scan files for all 810 stations were compared; the visible project contains one top-level unified 1.rcs plus the RCP Support tree.
No ReCap GUI open/save/reopen round trip was performed.
RCP UnitType and density values are kept raw; their enum/units are not decoded here.
